name: Cross-Seed Stuck Torrent Cleanup
description: Scheduled every 6 hours. Runs a Python script to find and remove stuck cross-seed torrents from Transmission that are incomplete and have aged out. Cleans up orphaned .torrent files from the cross-seed directory. Sends a Discord notification with an embed listing all removed torrents and their details. Only notifies if at least one torrent was removed.

parameters.command: command -v python3 > /dev/null 2>&1 || apk add --no-cache python3 > /dev/null 2>&1; python3 /mnt/e/Docker/n8n/scripts/cleanup_crossseed_stuck.py --json --rpc-url http://transmission:9091/transmission/rpc/ --cross-seed-dir /mnt/e/Docker/cross-seed/config/cross-seeds/
